title: LordBeck's Boredom Pack
description: Pack made by LordBeck when he was bored in class (it was online)
body:
LordBeck's Boredom Pack is a simple pvp-aimed resourcepack made by LordBeck when he was bored during class.

Right now (as if I am ever going to update this...), except for sword, apple and fire textures, is just a 1.14 edit*, but it was** planned to be changed in the future.

Also available as an **[Item Overlay](https://modrinth.com/project/lordbecks-boredom-item-overlay)**, where only the few item textures are included.

_*also 4 other items, which are in every single one of my packs made since Mancraft 16x - Sweaty Edition. They're in the gallery_\
_**it no longer "is", I'm just copy-pasting the old [curseforge page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/lordbecks-boredom-pack) description._
